bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 30 日均线，守住 10 日均线

read.en: Broadcom fell 3.9% on Nov 16 to $333.40, trading $327.80–337.74. It is above the 10-day ($328.4, rising), and below the 5-day ($344.4), 30-day ($338.6, falling), 100-day ($364.3) and 200-day ($367.4). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram easing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($297.28), and RSI is 48.8.
read.zh: 博通 11月16日下跌 3.9%，收于 $333.40，盘中区间 $327.80–337.74。股价位于 10 日均线（$328.4，上行）上方，位于 5 日（$344.4）、30 日（$338.6，下行）、100 日（$364.3）和 200 日均线（$367.4）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$297.28），RSI 为 48.8。

read.en: The drop broke the 30-day and the $337.7–344.3 support (Nov 13 and 11 lows), now resistance; the $327.80 low held the 10-day. Resistance is $337.7–338.6, then $344.3–347 (5-day, Nov 13 close) and $350.1–358.5. Support is $327.8–328.4 (10-day, Nov 16 low), then $316.7–319.5 (Nov 10 low, Nov 9 close) and $297.3 (SAR). A close above $338.6 would target $344–347; below $327.8, $317–319.5.
